text:
marco: Quick sync — we need a cutover plan for the siloed landing pages and the webinar post. Main needs: redirects, schema updates (FAQ/LD+JSON), canonical tags, and a staging QA window.

olivia: +1. timeline preference? we want redirects live before webinar email goes out.

marco: Targeting Wed 10pm PT for cutover so indexing stabilizes before Thurs promo. Phases: 1) staging redirect map, 2) QA + schema injection, 3) soft 302s -> then swap to 301 after 48h, 4) monitor Search Console + organic CTR.

ana: I can own the schema snippets. Will add `FAQPage` and `BreadcrumbList` where appropriate. Need URL list and canonical rules.

devon: I'll own the redirect rules. Proposed format:
```
/source-webinar -> /webinar-2026-something 302
/old-silo/topic-a -> /silo/topic-a 301
```
Will put full CSV into the doc.

marco: link to working doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/silo-cutover (please add rows).

seo-bot: Automated check scheduled: crawl-staging-redirects @ 1719060000, will report 301s, hreflang, canonical conflicts.

olivia: QA checklist (short):
- verify 302->301 flip after 48h
- structured data renders in page source
- no multiple canonicals
- redirects preserve utm params

ana: Also: add meta description templates for the new landing pages so we don't lose snippets.

devon: I'll coordinate with eng-runtime for the CDN purge window. @marco what's the rollback plan if something breaks?

marco: Rollback = revert redirects to staging mapping + re-enable old pages behind feature-flag, 30min SLA for emergency revert. If blocked, notify eng-oncall and SEO channel.

olivia: Assign owners: Redirects (devon), Schema (ana), QA (olivia), Monitoring (marco). I'll create the calendar invite for Wed 9pm PT dry run. :calendar:

marco: Awesome. Please add the final CSV by EOD tomorrow. We'll cut release notes and an internal FYI before the flip. :thumbsup:
